Line Down

The Hold Line Mysteries · Book 1

A whispered 911 call. A Harvest Queen stage. And a killer the whole town loves. Marcy Hale, 52, spent twenty-five years as Winnow Hollow's 911 dispatcher — she knows every address, every voice, every secret this small town ever tried to whisper past her. One stormy night she takes a call that won't let go… and four days later, the caller is dead. A classic fair-play cozy mystery: a cut padlock, a torn ledger page, a singed clue in a burn barrel — clean, warm, and full of small-town heart.

Start the series free — then keep going with Forty-Two Jars, Book 2, below.

How buying works

1 · Pick your book

Every ebook on this page is sold through PayPal — no bookstore account required. Checkouts are opening title by title: when a book's button turns gold, it's live.

2 · Pay with PayPal

Tap “Buy with PayPal” on any live title and check out with PayPal, Venmo, or a card on PayPal's secure page.

3 · Get your files

After payment, Bryan sends your ebook — EPUB + PDF for books, a download link for stencil packs. Read on any phone, tablet, or e-reader.
